description: Authorised retailer of headphones, running shoes and bags since 2014. Orders placed before 3pm are dispatched the same day from our Singapore warehouse. Every item is brand-new and covered by the manufacturer's warranty.

merchant_reviews.title: Fast and well packed
merchant_reviews.text: Ordered on Monday afternoon, arrived Tuesday morning. Box was sealed and the receipt was inside.

merchant_reviews.title: Easy exchange
merchant_reviews.text: Swapped a size without any fuss. The refund for the price difference came back to my card in three days.

merchant_reviews.title: Reliable store
merchant_reviews.text: Prices are not the cheapest but I have never had a problem in four orders.

merchant_reviews.title: Helpful support
merchant_reviews.text: Asked about warranty registration and got a clear answer by email the same day.

merchant_reviews.title: Fine

merchant_reviews.title: Would buy again
